stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: The witness gives a clear statement to the investigator.
items.sentenceZh: 证人向调查员作出清楚的陈述。
items.scene: In a quiet office, an adult witness speaks carefully while an investigator listens and records the account with simple text-free sketches. The witness gestures toward a small sequence of three object icons, communicating a formal factual statement without readable writing.
items.altText: 证人在安静办公室向调查员清楚陈述情况，调查员认真记录。

items.sentenceEn: Regular care helps maintain the bicycle.
items.sentenceZh: 定期保养有助于维护自行车。
items.scene: An adult mechanic performs routine care on a well-used bicycle, oiling the chain, checking tire pressure and tightening one bolt while the bicycle remains clean and functional. Organized tools and preventive attention communicate maintenance.
items.altText: 机械师给自行车链条上油、检查轮胎并拧紧螺栓，进行日常维护。

items.sentenceEn: The solar panel can charge the portable battery.
items.sentenceZh: 太阳能板可以给便携电池充电。
items.scene: In bright sunlight, one compact solar panel connects by a visible cable to one portable battery pack. A sequence of simple glowing dots travels along the cable into the battery, whose icon-only level indicator visibly fills with no text or numbers.
items.altText: 太阳能板通过电线向便携电池输送能量并为其充电。

items.meaningZh: 流行的；受欢迎的；大众的
items.sentenceEn: The bakery is popular with local customers.
items.sentenceZh: 这家面包店很受当地顾客欢迎。
items.scene: At a neighborhood market, many adults form a cheerful orderly line at one bakery stall with abundant fresh bread, while neighboring stalls have only one or two visitors. The strong crowd preference communicates popularity without signs or text.
items.altText: 社区市场中，许多顾客排队购买同一家面包店的面包。

items.sentenceEn: The artisan uses a traditional weaving method.
items.sentenceZh: 这位工匠使用传统的编织方法。
items.scene: An experienced adult artisan works at a hand-operated wooden loom using a time-honored weaving technique, while a younger adult learns beside them. Natural fibers, inherited tools and careful demonstration convey traditional craft without exoticizing the subjects.
items.altText: 经验丰富的工匠在木织机上示范传统编织方法，年轻人从旁学习。

items.sentenceEn: The cat jumps onto the empty chair.
items.sentenceZh: 猫跳到空椅子上。
items.scene: Exactly one cat is captured mid-jump from the floor toward the seat of one empty chair, with a clear rising arc and front paws already reaching over the seat. No other animals or chairs distract from the upward destination.
items.altText: 一只猫沿着上升弧线从地面跳向空椅子的座面。

items.sentenceEn: The conservator lifts the cloth to reveal the restored painting.
items.sentenceZh: 修复师掀开布，展现修复后的画作。
items.scene: An adult art conservator pulls a protective cloth aside from a newly restored landscape painting as two colleagues react with delighted surprise. The cloth still covers one edge, making the act of revealing visible and immediate.
items.altText: 修复师掀开保护布，露出修复完成的风景画。

items.sentenceEn: The compass shows the direction of the mountain pass.
items.sentenceZh: 指南针显示了山口的方向。
items.scene: Two adult hikers hold a simple compass with an unmarked needle aligned toward a visible mountain pass. Their gaze and one clearly curving trail continue in the same direction through the valley, with no letters or map labels.
items.altText: 徒步者查看指南针，指针与通往山口的小路方向一致。

items.sentenceEn: The old sword is displayed as a weapon from the past.
items.sentenceZh: 这把古剑作为过去的武器陈列。
items.scene: Inside a museum gallery, one sheathed historical sword rests safely behind glass on a secure display mount while an adult curator explains it to two visitors. No one touches or uses it, and there is no combat, injury, blood or threatening posture.
items.altText: 博物馆玻璃展柜内安全陈列着一把入鞘古剑，讲解员向访客介绍。

items.sentenceEn: The employee prepares each bakery order carefully.
items.sentenceZh: 这名雇员认真准备每一份面包店订单。
items.scene: A bakery employee wearing a plain apron carefully packs bread behind the service counter while a supervisor checks supplies nearby and a customer waits. Workstation, coordinated roles and attentive service establish the employee relationship without badges or text.
items.altText: 面包店雇员在柜台后认真包装面包，主管在旁检查物料。

items.sentenceEn: The museum hosts a cultural festival for the community.
items.sentenceZh: 博物馆为社区举办文化节。
items.scene: In a museum courtyard, community members respectfully share music, dance, textile craft and food traditions at several small stations. Participants teach and learn from one another in an inclusive setting, with no national flags, costumes used as caricatures, signs or text.
items.altText: 博物馆庭院的文化节上，社区成员分享音乐、舞蹈、织物工艺和食物传统。

items.sentenceEn: The glass jar can contain five seashells.
items.sentenceZh: 这个玻璃罐可以装下五枚贝壳。
items.scene: One transparent glass jar clearly contains exactly five distinct seashells, all fully inside its visible boundary, while the surrounding table remains empty. No extra shell motifs or shell-shaped objects appear.
items.altText: 一个透明玻璃罐内完整装着正好五枚不同的贝壳。

items.sentenceEn: The two villages celebrate peace together.
items.sentenceZh: 两个村庄共同庆祝和平。
items.scene: Adults and children from two neighboring villages meet peacefully at the center of a reopened footbridge, exchange baskets of food and plant one young olive tree together. Relaxed faces, open hands and shared activity convey peace without political symbols.
items.altText: 两个邻村的人们在重新开放的桥上互赠食物并共同种下一棵树。

items.sentenceEn: The runner feels pain in her ankle.
items.sentenceZh: 跑步者感到脚踝疼痛。
items.scene: An adult runner sits safely on a park bench holding one ankle with a clear wince while a friend offers a cold pack. A subtle red warmth around the ankle indicates pain, with no wound, swelling, blood or graphic injury.
items.altText: 跑步者坐在长椅上捂着疼痛的脚踝，朋友递来冷敷袋。

items.sentenceEn: She will apply sunscreen before the hike.
items.sentenceZh: 她会在徒步前涂抹防晒霜。
items.scene: At a sunny trailhead, an adult hiker squeezes sunscreen from a plain unmarked bottle and rubs it evenly onto her forearm before lifting her backpack. Bright sun and the visible cream being spread make application clear.
items.altText: 徒步者在出发前把防晒霜均匀涂在前臂上。

items.sentenceEn: The carpenter uses a tape to measure the table.
items.sentenceZh: 木匠用卷尺测量桌子。
items.scene: An adult carpenter stretches an unnumbered measuring tape exactly across the width of a wooden tabletop and marks the endpoint with a pencil. The aligned tape and focused gaze clearly communicate measurement without readable numbers.
items.altText: 木匠把无数字卷尺横跨木桌宽度，并用铅笔标记端点。

items.sentenceEn: The river is wide near the city.
items.sentenceZh: 城市附近的河流很宽。
items.scene: An elevated landscape view shows a broad river spanning most of the frame beside a compact city, with one small ferry and a very long bridge providing scale. A narrow upstream section in the distance creates a clear width comparison.
items.altText: 城市旁的河流横跨大部分画面，小渡船和长桥衬托其宽阔。

items.sentenceEn: The wet dog will shake water from its fur.
items.sentenceZh: 湿狗会抖掉毛发上的水。
items.scene: Exactly one wet dog stands after a bath and vigorously twists its head and body, sending a circular spray of water droplets outward. Curved motion marks, swinging ears and rippling fur make the shaking action unmistakable.
items.altText: 一只湿狗猛烈扭动身体和头部，把水珠向四周抖落。

items.sentenceEn: The geese fly across the sunset sky.
items.sentenceZh: 雁群飞过日落天空。
items.scene: A small formation of five geese flies high across an open sunset sky above a quiet wetland, wings visibly extended at different beats. Clear air surrounds the flock and no other flying objects appear.
items.altText: 五只雁排成小队，展开翅膀飞过湿地上方的日落天空。

items.sentenceEn: The candidate answers questions during the interview.
items.sentenceZh: 候选人在面试中回答问题。
items.scene: In a calm office, one adult job candidate sits across a small table from two interviewers, answers thoughtfully and maintains attentive eye contact. A closed portfolio and water glasses support the professional setting without résumés, screens or readable text.
items.altText: 办公室里，一名候选人坐在两位面试官对面认真回答问题。
